title: Layer 3: China Resilience Indicators
title_zh: 第三层：中国抗打击力指标
desc: Whether China's relative advantage materializes depends on these
desc_zh: 中国相对优势能否兑现，取决于这些

tradeSurplus.value: $119.09B (August) — new record · exports +25% YoY to $401.44B · imports +28.2% (missed 30% est.) · exports to US +34.4%
tradeSurplus.threshold: Record high. Sustained >$100B = structural advantage confirmed
tradeSurplus.threshold_zh: 创纪录。持续>$1000亿=结构优势确认
tradeSurplus.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): AUGUST SURPLUS HIT A RECORD $119.09B — up from $112.5B in July, vs ~$101.01B a year earlier (China Customs, released Sep 8; CNBC/Reuters/AP). Exports +25% YoY in USD terms to $401.44B, matching forecast and accelerating from +23.9% in July; imports +28.2%, missing the 30% Reuters-polled estimate but gathering momentum from +27.5%. Exports to the US surged 34.4% to $42.5B (partly a base effect after last year's high tariffs), while US exports to China were $13.3B — a bilateral surplus of ~$29.2B in China's favour. Exports to the EU +6.6%, Southeast Asia +30.2%, Latin America +17.5%; imports from South Korea more than doubled while exports there rose nearly 50%. Exports are now the primary growth engine as domestic demand stays tepid and investment slumps; ING's Lynn Song: exports 'set to lead to a new record-high trade surplus this year'; Pinpoint's Zhiwei Zhang: 'China continues to rely on exporters to support the economy'. Political friction rising in parallel: G20 finance ministers in the US issued a joint statement criticising economies that rely heavily on exports — China the only dissenting member (Bessent/China exchanges, Sep 1); Beijing pushed back Sep 3 calling the complaints 'an excuse to pressure and restrict China'. CFR's Brad Setser estimates the yuan is undervalued by ~20%. Xi Jinping's high-stakes visit to Washington is scheduled for later this month — unlikely to be derailed by the trade friction. CONTEXT: July surplus was $112.5B; Jan-Jul $687.37B; June record was $125.62B. Domestic demand remains weak (July retail +0.6%, Q2 GDP 4.3%). Hormuz escalation (Brent >$100) is a two-sided risk — costlier energy imports vs competitive advantage in manufacturing. Updated 2026-09-20
tradeSurplus.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：8月顺差创纪录达$1190.9亿——高于7月的$1125亿，去年同期约$1010.1亿（中国海关9月8日发布；CNBC/路透/AP）。以美元计出口同比+25%至$4014.4亿，与预期一致并较7月的+23.9%加速；进口+28.2%，低于路透调查的30%预期，但较+27.5%动能增强。对美出口激增34.4%至$425亿（部分因去年同期高关税导致的低基数），美国对华出口$133亿——中方顺差约$292亿。对欧盟出口+6.6%、东南亚+30.2%、拉美+17.5%；自韩国进口翻倍以上，对韩出口增长近50%。在内需疲弱、投资低迷下，出口已成为主要增长引擎；ING的Lynn Song：出口'将推动今年贸易顺差创历史新高'；Pinpoint的张文朗：'中国继续依赖出口商支撑经济'。政治摩擦同步升温：G20财长在美国发表联合声明批评严重依赖出口的经济体——中国是唯一持异议成员（贝森特/中国交锋，9月1日）；北京9月3日反驳称相关抱怨是'施压和限制中国的借口'。CFR的Brad Setser估计人民币被低估约20%。习近平本月晚些时候对华盛顿的高规格访问——不太可能因贸易摩擦而取消。背景：7月顺差$1125亿；1-7月$6873.7亿；6月创纪录为$1256.2亿。内需仍弱（7月零售+0.6%，二季度GDP 4.3%）。霍尔木兹升级（布伦特>$100）是双向风险——能源进口成本上升 vs 制造业竞争优势。更新于 2026-09-20

industrialProfits.threshold: Positive = cost pass-through working; Negative = margin squeeze
industrialProfits.threshold_zh: 正数=成本传导能力ok；负数=利润被挤压
industrialProfits.note: Jan-Jul +17.6% (¥4.58T, NBS Aug 27) — below Bloomberg Economics' 18.1% forecast; July alone +11.2% (third straight slowdown, weakest this year; June was +15.1%). Electronics led: profits +110% in Jan-Jul (contributed 9.3pp); integrated circuits +18.5x (>80% of electronics increase); raw-material makers +7.1pp; mining +34.9%, manufacturing +18.8%, utilities -5.8%. Weak spots: ferrous metals -51.2%, autos -20.4%, furniture -51% (property slump); property investment -19.2% Jan-Jul. Revenue +6.5% (¥80.92T), costs +5.9% — raw-material prices squeezing mid/downstream margins (ANZ). NBS: 'AI Plus' + computing-power demand main driver; 新动能 >40% of growth but weaker job/income creation than property/infra (PKU Su Jian). No new NBS data at the Sep 13 check — Jan-Aug profits due ~Sept 27. Updated 2026-09-20
industrialProfits.note_zh: 1-7月+17.6%（¥4.58万亿，统计局8月27日发布）——低于彭博经济研究的18.1%预测；7月单月+11.2%（连续第三个月放缓，年内最弱；6月为+15.1%）。电子行业领涨：1-7月利润+110%（贡献9.3个百分点）；集成电路+18.5倍（占电子行业增幅80%以上）；原材料制造贡献7.1个百分点；采矿业+34.9%、制造业+18.8%、公用事业-5.8%。薄弱环节：黑色金属冶炼-51.2%、汽车-20.4%、家具-51%（地产拖累）；1-7月房地产投资-19.2%。营收+6.5%（¥80.92万亿）、成本+5.9%——原材料涨价挤压中下游利润率（澳新银行）。统计局：'AI+'与算力需求是主要驱动；新动能占经济增长40%以上，但创造就业和收入能力弱于地产和基建等传统引擎（北大苏剑）。本周期无新统计局数据——1-8月利润约9月27日发布。更新于 2026-09-20

fxSettlement.value: Net settlement surplus ¥124.1B (Jul) — settlement ¥1,809.7B vs sales ¥1,685.6B
fxSettlement.value_zh: 7月净结汇顺差¥1241亿——结汇¥1.81万亿 vs 售汇¥1.69万亿
fxSettlement.note: July 2026 (SAFE, released Aug 17): bank FX settlement ¥1,809.7B vs sales ¥1,685.6B — NET SETTLEMENT SURPLUS ¥124.1B (exporters converting USD to RMB, bullish signal). Jan-Jul: settlement ¥12,602.0B vs sales ¥10,604.8B (net surplus ¥1,997.2B); H1 settlement+sales $2.9T, +24% YoY (record). RMB strong (USD/CNY 6.73 on Aug 28, +5.5% YoY; CFETS 102.12 Aug 14) + record trade surplus → exporter USD hoarding pressure limited. Hormuz oil cost shock remains watch item; Fed rate-hike hints (new Chair Warsh) are new external variable. No new SAFE data at the Sep 13 check — August data due ~Sept 17. Updated 2026-09-20
fxSettlement.note_zh: 2026年7月（外管局，8月17日发布）：银行结汇¥1.81万亿 vs 售汇¥1.69万亿——净结汇顺差¥1241亿（出口商结汇意愿强，看涨人民币信号）。1-7月：结汇¥12.60万亿 vs 售汇¥10.60万亿（净顺差¥1.99万亿）；上半年结售汇$2.9万亿，同比+24%（创纪录）。人民币强势（8月28日USD/CNY 6.73，同比+5.5%；CFETS 8月14日102.12）+创纪录贸易顺差→出口商囤美元压力有限。霍尔木兹油价冲击成本仍需关注；美联储加息暗示（新主席沃什）是新外部变量。本周期无外管局新数据——8月数据约9月17日发布。更新于 2026-09-20

cfetsIndex.threshold_zh: >104 = 央行可能干预；102-104 = 温和可控
cfetsIndex.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): INDEX SOFTENS AGAIN, SPOT RMB FIRM. CFETS RMB index 101.49 as of Sep 11 — DOWN 0.15 on the week from 101.64 on Sep 4 (official CFETS, via Eastmoney 国际金融要情, Sep 17); the BIS currency-basket index fell 0.13 to 108.61. Spot moved the other way: USD/CNY fell to 6.6947 on Sep 18 (TradingEconomics), the PBOC central parity was set at 6.7670 on Sep 15 and 6.7628 on Sep 16 (up 42 pips from 6.7795 on Sep 7), with onshore 6.7064 and offshore 6.7041 on Sep 16 — firmer than the 6.7075 print of Sep 11. Still far below the 104 intervention zone. Support unchanged: record August trade surplus and a firm spot RMB. PRIOR (checked 2026-09-13): CFETS RMB index 101.64 on Sep 4 — DOWN 0.23 on the week from 101.87 at end-August (official CFETS/Shanghai Securities News, 10jqka). This extends the modest consolidation that began after the May-Aug rally: monthly prints were 102.59 (Jun), 102.19 (Jul), 101.87 (Aug). Still far below the 104 intervention zone. Companion baskets at end-Aug: BIS basket 109.15, SDR basket 96.67. FX: USD/CNY 6.7075 on Sep 11 (TradingEconomics) — RMB +0.57% over the past month and +5.82% over 12 months, stronger than the 6.7298 print of Aug 28; the PBOC central parity was set at 6.7795 on Sep 7 (down 8 pips). PBOC daily fixings have run weaker than market levels since Nov 2025 — Beijing is deliberately capping yuan appreciation (Modern Diplomacy). Support: record August trade surplus ($119.09B, exports +25%) and July's record FX settlement surplus (¥124.1B). Two-way risks: Fed Chair Warsh's rate-hike hints vs renewed Hormuz escalation (Brent $104.61 on Sep 11). Watch the SAFE August data (~Sep 17) and whether CFETS re-tests 102. PRECEDING: 101.87 at end-Aug (down from 102.19 in July) — first dip after the May-Aug rally from 101.41 (Jun 2). Updated 2026-09-20
cfetsIndex.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-20）：指数续软，即期人民币走强。CFETS人民币指数9月11日报101.49——较9月4日的101.64周跌0.15（中国外汇交易中心官方数据，经东方财富《国际金融要情》9月17日）；BIS货币篮子指数跌0.13至108.61。即期方向相反：USD/CNY 9月18日跌至6.6947（TradingEconomics）；央行中间价9月15日6.7670、9月16日6.7628（较9月7日的6.7795上调42个基点），9月16日在岸6.7064、离岸6.7041——强于9月11日的6.7075。仍远低于104干预区。支撑因素未变：8月创纪录贸易顺差与即期人民币坚挺。前情（核查于2026-09-13）：CFETS人民币指数9月4日报101.64——较8月末的101.87周跌0.23（中国外汇交易中心官方数据/上海证券报，10jqka）。这延续了5-8月上行走势后的温和整固：月度值为102.59（6月）、102.19（7月）、101.87（8月）。仍远低于104干预区。同期篮子：BIS篮子8月末109.15、SDR篮子96.67。汇率：USD/CNY 9月11日报6.7075（TradingEconomics）——人民币近一个月升值0.57%、近12个月升值5.82%，较8月28日的6.7298进一步走强；央行9月7日中间价定于6.7795（下调8个基点）。央行中间价自2025年11月以来持续弱于市场价——北京有意抑制人民币升值（Modern Diplomacy）。支撑：8月创纪录贸易顺差（$1190.9亿，出口+25%）以及7月创纪录结汇顺差（¥1241亿）。双向风险：美联储主席沃什加息暗示 vs 霍尔木兹再度升级（9月11日布伦特$104.61）。关注外管局8月数据（约9月17日）及CFETS是否重新上探102。前情：8月末101.87（较7月102.19回落）——为5-8月从101.41（6月2日）上行后的首次回调。更新于 2026-09-20

chinaEvExports.note: NEW (checked 2026-09-20): AUGUST SET RECORDS AND CROSSED THE 2025 FULL-YEAR TOTAL. CAAM (released ~Sep 10): total vehicle exports 1.01M in August, +65.3% YoY — above 1M for a THIRD consecutive month; NEV exports 526K, up ~130% YoY and ~52.1% of total vehicle exports (above half for a third straight month); Jan-Aug NEV exports 3.435M (+124.3%) against total vehicle exports 7.153M (+66.7%). CPCA (Sep 8-9): passenger-car exports 888K (+77.8% YoY, -4.2% MoM) = 38% of automakers' total sales; passenger NEV exports 518K (+154.7%) = 58.4% of passenger exports, up 18pp YoY; BEVs 63.4% of NEV exports, PHEVs 32.9%, EREVs 3.7%. Top NEV exporters: BYD 183,746 (+130.8%, 35.4% share), Geely 69,910 (+440.2%), Chery 68,431 (+221.2%), Tesla China 36,119 (+38.7% YoY but -45.5% MoM, share down to 7.0% from 12.3%), Changan 28,323. Jan-Aug BYD 1,126,797 NEVs exported (+87.5%, 33.9% of market). Group totals: Chery 196,984 exports (+52.1%, 70.3% of its volume — first Chinese automaker past 7.18M cumulative exports); BYD 189,500 (record, 43% of group sales); Geely 110,094 (+205%, NEVs 70,600 = +446%); GWM 62,517. Electrek (Sep 10): China exported 6.2M passenger vehicles through August — already more than all of 2025 (6.1M) with four months to go; full-year track ~9-10M. Domestic mirror-image: CAAM total NEV sales +17.8% to 1.643M, a record 60.6% of all new vehicle sales, but DOMESTIC NEV sales fell 4.6% (domestic passenger NEV -8.2%); narrow passenger retail ~1.58M, down 20%+ YoY; NEV retail penetration 65.8%; wholesale is running ~2.7M units above retail YTD — the export/inventory wedge. Trade defence closing in: the EU extended countervailing duties to PHEVs in late August; Turkey, Brazil and Indonesia raised local-content/tariff walls. Strategic answer from all four majors: shift from shipping to overseas assembly (BYD Hungary/Brazil, Chery Spain/Indonesia, Geely footprint) — ramping through 2027. Updated 2026-09-20
chinaEvExports.note_zh: 新（核查于2026-09-13）：8月创多项纪录，并已超越2025年全年出口总量。中汽协（约9月10日发布）：8月汽车出口101万辆，同比+65.3%——连续第三个月超过100万辆；新能源出口52.6万辆，同比+约130%，占汽车出口约52.1%（连续第三个月过半）；1-8月新能源出口343.5万辆（+124.3%），汽车出口合计715.3万辆（+66.7%）。乘联会（9月8-9日）：乘用车出口88.8万辆（同比+77.8%，环比-4.2%），占车企总销量38%；乘用车新能源出口51.8万辆（+154.7%），占乘用车出口58.4%，同比提升18个百分点；纯电占新能源出口63.4%、插混32.9%、增程3.7%。新能源出口前五：比亚迪183,746辆（+130.8%，份额35.4%）、吉利69,910辆（+440.2%）、奇瑞68,431辆（+221.2%）、特斯拉中国36,119辆（同比+38.7%但环比-45.5%，份额从12.3%降至7.0%）、长安28,323辆。1-8月比亚迪累计出口新能源1,126,797辆（+87.5%，占市场33.9%）。集团口径：奇瑞出口196,984辆（+52.1%，占其销量70.3%——首家累计出口突破718万辆的中国车企）；比亚迪189,500辆（创纪录，占集团销量43%）；吉利110,094辆（+205%，其中新能源70,600辆=+446%）；长城62,517辆。Electrek（9月10日）：中国1-8月出口乘用车620万辆——已超过2025年全年（610万辆），尚有四个月；全年有望达900-1000万辆。国内镜像：中汽协新能源总销量+17.8%至164.3万辆，占全部新车销量创纪录的60.6%，但国内新能源销量下降4.6%（国内乘用车新能源-8.2%）；狭义乘用车零售约158万辆，同比降20%以上；新能源零售渗透率65.8%；年内批发较零售高出约270万辆——出口/库存楔形。贸易防御收紧：欧盟8月底将反补贴关税扩至插电混动；土耳其、巴西、印尼提高本地含量/关税门槛。四大出口车企的战略回应一致：从整车发运转向海外组装（比亚迪匈牙利/巴西、奇瑞西班牙/印尼、吉利海外布局）——2027年前逐步放量。更新于 2026-09-20
